title: Legacy-program insider: the answers are in Crystal City

tellings.quote: There was one firsthand uh legacy guy, a friend of mine I was speaking to once and he said that the answer to most of what you're looking for is in Crystal City, Virginia.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says a friend of his, a firsthand insider from a "legacy program", meaning a long-running secret government effort said to study non-human craft, once gave him a tip. According to UAPGerb, the friend said the answer to most of what he was looking for is in Crystal City, Virginia. If true, it would point to where that secret work is run.
